# Vercel icon, History, help, and Pricing refinements

The final History treatment follows the two follow-up requests: role chips use
the same **blue highlight** as template placeholders, and recipient avatars have
a black background with white initials. Company/template chips and row hover
remain neutral. Purple retains its layout and icon styling; the later request
also brightens its light-mode amber. Purple dark yellow remains unchanged.

Compose has no blue feature tiles requiring a change. On Templates and Contacts,
only explicit icon markers and the subsequently requested semantic color
updates apply; their blue fields, selections, links, placeholders, and controls
keep their existing styling. Settings' ordinary icon tiles also receive the neutral treatment; warning/error icons remain semantic.
Shared help hints and walkthroughs receive the new styling on all workspace pages.

Usage changes from this task are limited to the subsequently requested semantic
green/amber colors. Separate concurrent work changed Usage's plan presentation
and the shared appearance controls during this task; that work was preserved.
Consequently, whole-page baseline screenshot differences may include those independent edits and changed header dimensions.

## Files changed by this task

- `src/app/globals.css`: brighter Purple light amber text/surfaces, with the
  existing Purple dark values retained.
- `src/components/usage/usage.module.css`,
  `src/components/settings/settings.module.css`,
  `src/components/ui/Tooltip.module.css`: semantic green/amber token updates only.
- `src/app/workspace-theme.css`: explicit icon tokens, History/portal neutral
  aliases, shared help styles, and consistent older History table selectors.
- `src/app/(app)/history/page.tsx`: History styling boundary class.
- `src/components/history/history.module.css`: role chip, tile outline, avatar.
- `src/components/history/HistoryStats.tsx`: neutral Send/Replies tile tints;
  queued remains amber.
- `src/components/history/StatCard.tsx`, `HistoryInfoRow.tsx`, `StatusBadge.tsx`,
  `RowActions.tsx`: History tooltip surface classes.
- `src/components/contacts/ImportContacts.tsx`, `ContactsEmptyState.tsx`:
  explicit icon tile classes, with no other component changes.
- `src/components/templates/TemplatesFreeView.tsx`: explicit empty-state glyph
  class, with no other component changes.
- `src/components/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx`, `ResumeUpload.tsx`: ordinary
  icon tile classes; Danger Zone retains its semantic treatment.
- `src/components/pricing/pricing.css`: Vercel-only light/dark Pricing styles
  and direct-load font registration using the existing bundled Inter file.
- `tests/browser/app.spec.ts`: refinement matrix, History avatars/chips/filter/
  hover/focus checks, every walkthrough step, Pricing and protected page checks.
  This file also contains concurrent appearance-selector test updates.
- `design/vercel-refinement/README.md` and selected screenshots: delivery record.

No API, database schema, billing logic, prices, or content changes.

## Tokens

| New token                   | Light     | Dark      |
| --------------------------- | --------- | --------- |
| `--workspace-icon-bg`       | `#EDEDED` | `#232323` |
| `--workspace-icon-ink`      | `#171717` | `#F2F2F2` |
| `--workspace-icon-border`   | `#D4D4D4` | `#333333` |
| `--history-role-text`       | `#1E40AF` | `#BFDBFE` |
| `--history-role-background` | `#DBEAFE` | `#142C4F` |
| `--history-role-border`     | `#93C5FD` | `#365E91` |
| `--pricing-coral`           | `#AC412F` | `#E8765A` |
| `--pricing-primary`         | `#171717` | `#F5F5F5` |
| `--pricing-primary-ink`     | `#FFFFFF` | `#0A0A0A` |
| `--pricing-tile`            | `#EDEDED` | `#232323` |
| `--pricing-tile-line`       | `#D4D4D4` | `#333333` |

History company/template chips use locally overridden `--highlight-background`,
`--highlight-foreground`, and `--highlight-border`: `#EDEDED/#171717/#D4D4D4`
in light and `#232323/#F2F2F2/#333333` in dark. Links, progress and focus use
`--foreground` through local `--link`, `--ring`, `--progress-fill`, and
`--appearance-*` aliases; replied badges are neutral. Portaled tooltips carry
these same aliases via `history-surface`. `--button-hover-filter` and
`--appearance-focus-shadow` are disabled in these local surfaces.

History avatars retain their 40px circular dimensions and use `#0A0A0A/#FFFFFF`
in both Vercel modes. No global brand logo override is introduced.

Help locally maps highlights, links, progress and placeholder previews to the
existing neutral surface/foreground/border tokens. Queued/warning, success, and
error colors retain their semantic meaning. Miniature rings use solid green or
amber outlines instead of a conic gradient.

Pricing's existing local tokens are overridden only under the Vercel appearance:
`--bg`, `--bg2`, `--card`, `--line`, `--line2`, `--tx`, `--mu`, `--pu`, `--pk`,
`--gr`, `--ye`, and `--grad`. Dark uses `#0A0A0A` canvas, `#141414` cards,
`#1E1E1E` insets, `#F2F2F2` text, `#A3A3A3` secondary text, and `#4FB87A`
checks. Light uses neutral light surfaces and dark text. Corners are 20px on
cards, 14px on actions, and 8px on badges. The public route stays outside the
workspace boundary and follows the saved appearance.

## Verification

```sh
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npx vitest run tests/appearance.test.ts tests/usage-allowance-state.test.ts
npx tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only '--browser=app.spec.ts,pricing.spec.ts,--grep,Vercel refinement boundaries|public pricing,--output=/tmp/mailloop-vercel-refinement/final-results'
```

The browser matrix covers both appearances, both light/dark modes, desktop and
mobile. It checks all seven routes, all walkthrough steps, neutral icons, blue
History role chips, white-on-black initials, neutral company/template highlights,
row hover, keyboard tooltip focus, filters, overflow, direct Pricing loads,
localized price text, and automated axe accessibility/contrast checks.

Source comparisons confirm this task leaves Compose and the Templates/Contacts
stylesheet contents unchanged. Their existing blue link tokens are also asserted
in the browser. Baseline captures and raw run artifacts are isolated under
`/tmp/mailloop-vercel-refinement/` to avoid collisions with concurrent checks.

### Follow-up semantic colors

- Vercel green: `--success` / `--status-success-text` use `#176B3A` in light
  and deeper `#4FB87A` in dark. Pricing checks follow the same values. Usage's
  always-dark content uses `#4FB87A` in both modes.
- Vercel light amber: text `#946200`, visual queued fill `#D69B18`, warning
  background `#FFF3C4`, and recipient warning border `#E8C25A`. Dark amber stays
  unchanged.
- Purple light amber: text `#946200`, warning background `#FFF3C4`, premium
  notice border `#E8C25A`. Module-specific light warning labels now follow the
  shared status token. Purple dark values are explicitly preserved.
- Amber text contrast is at least 4.7:1 on the warm warning surface and 4.8:1
  on the light neutral surface. Deeper dark green is at least 6.7:1 on `#1E1E1E`.

The follow-up green also covers Vercel's Gmail connection dot and legacy sent
pills. Light-mode queue visuals and the connection dot use `#168A45`; the
light-mode queue amber uses `#C58A00`, while text keeps its accessible status color. History sent-badge backgrounds use `--appearance-sent-bg` with a Purple
fallback, so their tinted surface follows the deeper green.

Earlier shared changes were committed and pushed by a concurrent process
(`66b5d78` on `theme`, including earlier `97c9792`). The remaining refinements,
report, and screenshots are committed and pushed following the user's explicit
request. Those earlier commits are preserved.

The full 10-case matrix passed. A separate six-case pass checks the follow-up
semantic colors in Vercel light/dark and Purple light, on desktop and mobile:

```sh
npx tsx scripts/test-usage-db.ts --e2e-only '--browser=app.spec.ts,--grep,Vercel refinement boundaries: (vercel|purple light),--output=/tmp/mailloop-vercel-refinement/colors-results'
```

Final verification: typecheck, lint, and `git diff --check` passed; 16 relevant
unit tests passed; the 10-case browser matrix and six follow-up color cases
passed with automated accessibility/contrast checks. The 12 review captures
above use the latest completed color pass.
